description: Every consulate that schedules or issues immigrant visas. For each category (employment, family preference and immediate relative), the month of documentarily complete cases it's scheduling and how many months behind that is. Also the visas it issued in the newest 12 published months. Each carries the slug the consulate endpoint takes. Example: {}.
name: list_consulates

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: Every consulate's immigrant visa interview line, from State's IV Scheduling Status Tool, and the visas each issued in the newest 12 months.
State's newest update to its scheduling tool, as YYYY-MM-DD.
The first of the 12 issuance months counted, as YYYY-MM.
The last of them, as YYYY-MM.

posts.description: Every post that schedules or issues immigrant visas, by name.

issuedLast12Months.description: Immigrant visas the post issued in the newest 12 published months. Null when State's tables couldn't be read.

anyOf.description: Where the post's immigrant visa interview line is, by category: employment, family preference and immediate relative.

employment.description: One category's place in the post's interview line.

asPrinted.description: The month as State printed it, e.g. Mar-2023, or N/A.

anyOf.description: The month of documentarily complete cases the post is scheduling, as YYYY-MM.

monthsBehind.description: Whole months between that month and State's update. 0 means caught up. Null where State shows no month.

family.description: One category's place in the post's interview line.

asPrinted.description: The month as State printed it, e.g. Mar-2023, or N/A.

anyOf.description: The month of documentarily complete cases the post is scheduling, as YYYY-MM.

monthsBehind.description: Whole months between that month and State's update. 0 means caught up. Null where State shows no month.

immediate.description: One category's place in the post's interview line.

asPrinted.description: The month as State printed it, e.g. Mar-2023, or N/A.

anyOf.description: The month of documentarily complete cases the post is scheduling, as YYYY-MM.

monthsBehind.description: Whole months between that month and State's update. 0 means caught up. Null where State shows no month.

scheduling.description: The post's line in State's newest update. Null for a post State's tool doesn't list.

slug.description: The post's name in its page's address.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: List the consulates' interview lines
